jobs.title: Senior Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.content: <p>We are a remote-first company.</p><h3>What you'll bring:</h3><ul><li>4+ years of experience in offensive security or red teaming</li><li>Deep knowledge of Active Directory, Kerberos and AD CS attacks</li><li>Strong Python or Rust for tooling</li><li>Experience with C2 frameworks such as Cobalt Strike or Sliver</li></ul><h3>Nice to have:</h3><ul><li>OSEP or CRTO</li><li>Experience with AWS</li></ul><p>Salary: EUR 70k - 95k per year</p>

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
